artworks.prompt: Real photograph: a single glowing lava bomb arcing through the night, a dark crusted rock with bright orange-yellow cracks, a short fading spark trail behind it. Nothing else. No smoke cloud.

Real long-exposure photograph: a bold, dense swirl of many bright glowing orange-yellow ember sparks rising upward through the night air, filling about 65% of the frame, crisp bright points with short warm streaks, clearly visible. Nothing else.
Photographic, high detail, natural, like a crisp telephoto nature photograph: a common raven in flight at night, wings spread, black feathers lit from below by warm orange lava glow. No shadow.

A thin crescent moon, warm pale silver, crisp lunar detail on the lit limb, long-lens night photograph. ONLY the bright lit crescent is visible: the dark part of the moon is completely invisible, exactly the background colour (NO earthshine, no grey disc). Nothing else.

Real long-exposure night photograph: a single big bright fireball meteor streaking diagonally down across the frame, a large blazing white-gold head with a warm orange glow and a THICK, bold, bright glowing trail that tapers over about 70% of the frame width, very clearly visible, high contrast. Nothing else, no landscape.
